note: An experiment (GAME_SPEC §13.7, Stage 85; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 52) on data/benches/hardness.json: water's hardness by EDTA. At pH 10 EDTA takes calcium and magnesium one to one; Eriochrome Black T is wine red with magnesium and blue free, so the last of the magnesium taken turns it blue.
title: Experiment: water's hardness by EDTA

report.label: its hardness, as calcium carbonate
report.why: mg/L = c V M / 25.00 mL: 0.0100 M EDTA times the burette's difference times 100.09 g/mol, over the pipette's 25.00 mL. Hardness is counted as if all its calcium and magnesium were calcium carbonate: a water over 180 mg/L is very hard. The burette reads within 0.05 mL, about one per cent of the titre.

steps.title: 25.00 mL of the water
steps.text: Pick up the pipette and click the sample: it draws to its mark. Then click the flask: it stands in the flask and drains.

steps.title: The pipette away
steps.text: Pick up the pipette and click a free square.

steps.title: The buffer
steps.text: Pick up the buffer, right-click the flask, type 2 and click "pour".
steps.why: EDTA holds magnesium only at a high pH, and the dye is blue only between 7 and 11: the buffer holds the flask at pH 10 while the titration frees hydrogen ions.

steps.title: The indicator
steps.text: Pick up the Eriochrome Black T, right-click the flask, type 0.2 and click "pour". The flask turns wine red.
steps.why: The dye takes magnesium more tightly than calcium: wine red MgIn-. EDTA takes calcium first, then the free magnesium, then the magnesium from the dye, which turns blue.

checks.text: the dye in the flask, with magnesium

steps.title: Fill the burette
steps.text: Pick up the EDTA, right-click the burette, type 55 and click "pour". Then right-click the burette and click "+ mL".

steps.title: The burette over the flask, slowly
steps.text: Pick up the burette and click the flask. Then right-click the burette and drag its tap to about 3 %.
steps.why: The titre is a few millilitres: the whole of it runs in slowly, so the last drop past the change is small.

steps.title: Until it turns blue
steps.text: Watch the flask until the wine red turns to blue.

checks.text: the flask blue (a tenth of the dye still wine red)

steps.title: Shut it, and read it
steps.text: Drag the tap shut, then right-click the burette and click "+ mL".
